findings.resolution: Added ILL_FORMED_STRING error code and assertWellFormedString helper that scans for unpaired UTF-16 surrogates. Applied it to string values (encodeString), plain-object property keys (encodeObject), and encodingVersion (canonicalEncode). Updated ADR-009 §2 STRING and §5 to require well-formed UTF-16 across values, keys, and encodingVersion. Added tests: lone high surrogate, lone low surrogate, distinct lone surrogates rejected, surrogates inside object keys, Set elements, Map keys, encodingVersion; well-formed surrogate pair still accepted.

encodeObject now inspects each descriptor and throws CanonicalEncoderError with ACCESSOR_PROPERTY code when descriptor.get or descriptor.set is defined, before any property access. Property values are now read from descriptor.value rather than record[name], so no user code executes during encoding. Updated ADR-009 §2 OBJECT and §5 to document the accessor-descriptor rejection. Added tests: getter not invoked, throwing getter surfaces ACCESSOR_PROPERTY (not the getter's error), stateful getter never observed, setter-only accessor rejected, nested accessor rejected, non-enumerable accessors still ignored.
Executed and captured successful output for npm run compile, npm run boundary, npm run lint, and npm test (108 tests pass, 0 failures).

notes_for_reviewer: Well-formedness check scans char codes directly; no JSON.stringify or other lint-forbidden constructs are introduced (a JSON.stringify usage was replaced with plain string interpolation in error messages after lint caught it).

encodeObject now reads value from descriptor.value; this preserves the previous public behaviour for data properties (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor.value == record[name] for data descriptors) while eliminating any accessor invocation surface.
encodingVersion validation now runs both existing type/non-empty check and the new well-formedness check.
package.json and packages/core/package.json were modified in the prior implementation pass and were not touched again here; they remain part of the candidate diff.
payload.summary: Addressed the three review findings: rejected ill-formed UTF-16 strings uniformly across values, object keys, and encodingVersion with a new ILL_FORMED_STRING code; rejected plain-object accessor descriptors without invoking them with a new ACCESSOR_PROPERTY code (values now come from the descriptor's value field, so no getter can execute); updated ADR-009 to normatively document both rules; added collision and behavioural tests; and ran compile, boundary, lint, and the full test suite to completion.

validation.summary: tsc -b tsconfig.json completed with no errors across all 15 workspace projects.
